notes_for_editor: Only one dated record exists: the Forest Lookouts entry for the March 22, 2018 state surplus auction, which places the tower on the Franklin County headquarters property. The entry does not say whether the tower was in the auction or what happened to it. Two web searches for the auction result and any sale record found nothing tower-specific (results were unrelated Franklin County surplus sales and real-estate listings). The record's status stays unknown. Suggested checks: the NCFS Franklin County office (Voice 919-496-3665, per the ncagr contacts page) about whether a tower still stands and whether the 2018 surplus auction included it; a public records request for surplus disposal documents. The record has no height, design or build year; none is in any source read. The visit trail_note is a statement about the absence of rules, kept for the editor.
